summary: Example Meraki task creates an organization with meraki_organization using auth_key and org_name, delegated to localhost.
questions: How do I create a Meraki organization with Ansible?

answer_card.title: Example Meraki task
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- cisco.meraki.meraki_organization:
    auth_key: abc12345
    org_name: YourOrg
    state: present
  delegate_to: localhost
```
